working_definition: Author type Lawf2 (lamina wide-field neuron type 2) of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas, at the developing pupal stages P15/P30/P40 (~15-40 h APF), where cells are immature neurons.
searches_performed: ancestor walk of FBbt:00110065 for immature counterparts

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult lamina wide-field 2 neuron (Özel et al., 2021).

justification: 'Lawf2' is FBbt:00110065 'lamina wide-field 2 neuron' (mature set); at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so its immature form FBbt:00053683 (FBbt #2219, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Broader than the intrinsic-neuron immature term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A lamina wide-field neuron that has a main projection into the lamina making wide-field arborizations in the distal lamina, innervating 28 cartridges. These neurons also arborize in the medulla (Hasegawa et al., 2011). In the M1 layer, the branches are large and overlapping, encompassing around 120 cartridges. In medulla layers M8 to M10 the branches are smaller, encompassing around 17 cartridges and show less overlap. Putative cholinergic presynaptic sites are observed in the lamina.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature term; the stage is developing (P15-P40), which takes immature terms.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053683 'immature lamina wide-field 2 neuron' (exact match).
